title: Skill-RAG: Failure-State-Aware Retrieval Augmentation via Hidden-State Probing and Skill Routing
authors: Kai Wei; Raymond Li; Xi Zhu; Zhaoqian Xue; Jiaojiao Han; Jingcheng Niu; Fan Yang
why_relevant: Skill-RAG uses hidden-state probing to detect retrieval failure states and routes among corrective skills (rewrite, decompose, focus, exit), directly addressing adaptive retrieval control, abstention, and query-evidence misalignment under OOD conditions.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on failure-recovery routing rather than adversarial or conflict settings; does not address poisoning or knowledge conflict.
